column1: # Path-based skip cases for check-american-english, read by BOTH runners'
# test suites (tests/test-american-english.sh and .ps1). One table means the
#   expect  exit code the hook must return for a file at this path whose
#           content contains a flagged word (0 = skipped, 2 = blocked)
#   path    the file_path in the payload; backslashes are escaped by each
#           suite when it builds the JSON
#   label   what the case is called in the output
# The flagged word itself is never written here: each suite pulls one out of
# the runner's own word map at run time, so neither this table nor the suites
# trip the very hook they test (see the "Authoring gotcha" in the hooks README).
